subtitle: Walk, run, hop, skip
question: Where can your body go?
promise: This unit is about moving in the meadow and in the hall. You will walk a line, stop on a cone, and find out how fast your feet can go.
learn: Walk and run on a line
Hop, skip and join a partner

question: How many ways can you cross the meadow?
text: Pip runs. Bramble walks. Sorrel hops. Tuft rolls. Every body crosses the grass in its own way. Which way is yours?

title: Walk, run, stop
text: A walk has quiet feet. A run has fast feet. A stop is still feet, side by side. The chalk line shows you where to go.
say: Say 'freeze' and hold your own hand up. Feet stop when the hand goes up.

title: The chalk line
text: Walk the line to the cone. Run back along the line. Stop before you touch the cone.
ask: Draw your feet on the line. Mark where you stopped.

text: Sorrel stops in one step. Watch her front paws.

steps.text: Hop on one foot. Three hops, then swap.
Skip to the bench. Skip all the way back.
Hold a partner's hand. Move together.

text: Stand still on one foot. Count to three out loud. Then try the other foot. Nobody is racing you.

title: Fast and slow
text: Do each one. Then circle how it felt.

lead: Colour one circle for each line. There is no wrong answer here.
rescue: If the class cannot stop on the word, clap instead of saying it - feet stop on the clap.
